cues.text: In a back alley, a man in a suit stands waiting. You walk up to him.
You walk past him, deeper into the alley, to where Takaya waits beside some bins.
Takaya draws a revolver from his belt and turns it over in his hand as he talks, then tucks it back into his belt.
Takaya walks past you and away, the revolver tucked back in his belt.
